targetedComposition.reply: Getting started early helps here, because Medicare timing and the end of coverage through a spouse’s job do not always line up the same way.
targetedComposition.question: When would you like Medicare coverage to start?

educationalTurn.reply: Part B is the medical insurance part of Medicare. It helps cover doctor visits, outpatient care, tests, medical equipment, and many preventive services; together with Part A, it makes up Original Medicare.
